While it is signed by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition—a definitive characteristic of Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The minister's name and title are incidental to the execution of the land-related legal procedure, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes are described. Therefore, the specialized Land classification takes precedence.
